a.lede: With the November Patch Tuesday rollout, you can finally customize your right-click menu in Windows 11. It fixes 1,094 security flaws, too.
a.title: New Windows 11 update fixes File Explorer menu mess – and patches an exploited flaw

b.lede: Microsoft has confirmed that this month's Patch Tuesday security updates are causing Windows activation and licensing failures with 0x80041008 error codes. [...]
b.title: Microsoft confirms Windows activation failures after November updates
